$comment: Dubel Team football ecosystem contract. This file is IDENTICAL in all four repos (fanlife, Offsides, Dubid, The-Worker). Change it in one repo => copy the same bytes to the other three in the same round. Bump version + updated.

legacy.pqdzqpettxuuyngxbpxn: OFFSIDES' current production DB. Not in the same Supabase org. Moves into schema `offsides` on the shared project in phase 4. Until then OFFSIDES runs there.

authRules: No app adds triggers on auth.users. Profiles are created lazily by each app's own ensure_* RPC.
Every app adds only its own Redirect URLs; never change the Site URL without updating every app.
Sign-out is local (scope:'local') so leaving one app never signs the user out of the others.

core.what: football facts: leagues, seasons, teams, players, squads, matches, external_refs, entity_aliases

shared.what: reward_grants ledger, integration_health. Changes need all four repos updated.

hub.what: person profile, favourite club, consents, app_membership, leads, attribution, handoff

public.worker_*.rule: Only fanlife adds migrations. The-Worker mirrors the files byte-for-byte and never writes its own.

public.{arenas,bets,profiles,questions,s.rule: Legacy stubs from the first shared-project attempt. Do not use, do not drop until phase 4 decides.

edgeFunctions.offsides: sync-fixtures*, hyper-responder, sync-team-logos, momentum-odds, match-autopilot, daily-streak, duel-push, fb-post

migrations.theworker: mirror of fanlife's worker_* files only

crossAppLinks.how: RPC game.current_gameweek / game.gameweek_state with anon key

crossAppLinks.status: live, VIOLATION: cross-app table read; replace with shared view in phase 2

crossAppLinks.how: edge fn link-offsides verifies an Offsides token; rewards via shared.reward_grants -> offsides public.dubid_rewards

rules: 1. An app writes only to schemas it owns. Cross-app reads go through views/RPCs in core, hub or shared.
2. Currencies never mix. Value crosses apps only through shared.reward_grants.
3. Before any DB change: read the live object (pg_get_functiondef / list_tables) — never rebuild a live function from a repo file.
4. Never deploy a migration or edge function whose prefix belongs to another app.
5. A change to contract.json, shared or core is a four-repo change: same round, same contract version.
6. Football identity: every team/player an app shows must be resolvable to core via core.external_refs (phase 3).
7. Domains: all apps live under *.dubelteam.com (SSO cookie scope, phase 2).
